Class StackAdapterTest

java.lang.Object
myTest.StackAdapterTest
public class StackAdapterTest extends Object
Test suite for the StackAdapter class.

This test suite verifies the functionality of the StackAdapter class, which provides a last-in-first-out (LIFO) stack of objects. The adapter uses a Vector as its underlying data structure and implements the standard stack operations: push, pop, peek, empty, and search.

Test Case Design

The test cases are designed to validate the behavior of StackAdapter against the specifications of Java 1.4.2 Stack class. The test design includes categories for basic functionality, edge cases, error conditions, and compliance with the LIFO principle.

    • testDefaultConstructor

      public void testDefaultConstructor()
      Test method to verify that the default constructor creates an empty stack with initial capacity of 10.

      Summary:

      This test verifies that the default constructor initializes a StackAdapter instance correctly with size 0, capacity 10, and empty state.

      Test Case Design:

      The test is designed to validate the basic initialization behavior of the default constructor, ensuring proper initial state for subsequent operations.

      Test Description:

      The test creates a new StackAdapter using the default constructor and verifies that it is not null, has size 0, capacity 10, and is empty.

      Pre-Condition:

      - No stack instance exists

      Post-Condition:

      - StackAdapter instance is created with correct initial state

      Expected Results:

      Stack should be non-null, have size 0, capacity 10, and empty() should return true.

    • testDefaultConstructorCapacityGrowth

      public void testDefaultConstructorCapacityGrowth()
      Test method to verify capacity growth when pushing beyond initial capacity.

      Summary:

      This test verifies that the stack correctly grows its capacity when the number of elements exceeds the initial capacity.

      Test Case Design:

      The test is designed to validate the automatic capacity expansion mechanism of the underlying Vector implementation when used by StackAdapter.

      Test Description:

      The test pushes 11 elements onto a stack with initial capacity 10 and verifies that the capacity doubles to 20 while maintaining correct element order and size.

      Pre-Condition:

      - StackAdapter instance created with default constructor (capacity 10)

      Post-Condition:

      - Stack has size 11, capacity 20, and contains all pushed elements in correct order

      Expected Results:

      Stack should grow capacity to 20, maintain size 11, and preserve element insertion order.

    • testPushProperOrder

      public void testPushProperOrder()
      Test method to verify that push operations maintain LIFO order.

      Summary:

      This test verifies that push operations maintain proper Last-In-First-Out order in the stack.

      Test Case Design:

      The test is designed to validate the fundamental LIFO behavior of the stack data structure through sequential push and pop operations.

      Test Description:

      The test pushes three elements and verifies that pop operations return them in reverse (LIFO) order.

      Pre-Condition:

      - Empty StackAdapter instance

      Post-Condition:

      - Stack becomes empty after all pops

      - Elements are returned in LIFO order

      Expected Results:

      Elements should be popped in reverse order of pushing (3, 2, 1).

      Test Description:

      The test pushes two elements, verifies the position of an element, then pushes another element and verifies that the same element's position has changed.

      Pre-Condition:

      - StackAdapter instance with two elements: "1", "2"

      Post-Condition:

      - Stack contains three elements after push

      - Element "2" moves from position 1 to position 2

      Expected Results:

      After pushing "3", search("2") should return 2 (moved from position 1).
